title: CustomInstructionCreate
description: Fields for creating a custom instruction

title.description: Display name for the custom instruction (unique per Agent)

text.description: The instruction content — the rule the Agent should follow

enabled.description: Whether the instruction is enabled. False means inactive.

notes.description: Internal notes about this instruction (not shown to the Agent)

availability_rules.description: Optional availability rule as a rule-expression string with `v("<variable_name>")` lookups. Omit or send `null` for no rule. A rule that references an unknown variable, or that is malformed or uses an unsupported operator, is rejected with 400.
